title: 第6章 庄静白归来
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
看着陆沉离开，胡伟端起茶盏，慢悠悠地喝了一口。

    “夫人，你说这小子，是不是有什么事瞒着我，总感觉他心里装着什么事儿？”

    陈雪娇睫毛微颤，脸上却不动声色：“能有什么事？孩子大了，有自己的心思罢了。”

    “也是。”胡伟点点头，“就是太不让人省心了。这个时候了还不成亲，这像话吗？”

    陈雪娇垂下眼眸，轻轻“嗯”了一声，指尖却微微收紧。

    “师父，师兄他是个有主见的人，想来很快就会找到道侣的！”张帆站出来适当的开口。

    “你少给他打掩护！老夫还没说你的问题呢！你只是双灵根，修炼速度比你师兄快一倍有余，到现在还只是筑基八重，修炼都修到狗身上去了？”

    张帆：“……”

    他是看出来了，老登就是想训人了，无论怎么做都不行。

    “跟我来吧，我拿点小礼物给我徒孙！”胡伟说着，便起身向着屋内走去。

    “是！”张帆连忙抱着自己儿子跟了进去，陈雪娇和玉凝则是在外面等候。

    目送丈夫离开，陈雪娇才缓缓松了口气，抬手按了按心口。

    那里刚刚跳得有些快。

    但只是这么一个微小的动作，也被玉凝收入眼中。

    ……

    两天时间，一晃而过。

    胡伟说的没错，从庄静白回去告状之后，庄父竟然真的带着一堆月华宫的修士来玄天宗讨要说法了！

    玄天宗议事大殿内，气氛凝重。

    林天垂着头站在大殿中央，身旁是满脸尴尬的玄天宗宗主和几位首座。

    陆沉也被胡伟拉着在一旁看戏。

    对面，月华宫的人马气势汹汹。

    为首的中年男子一身玄色长袍，面容威严，正是月华宫宫主，庄静白的父亲，庄天涯。

    他身后站着十余名月华宫长老，个个气息深沉，最低都是金丹修为。

    而庄静白站在父亲身侧，一袭白衣，面色冷淡，目光落在林天身上，看不出喜怒。

    “林天！你可知罪？！”

    林天闻言腿一软，差点跪下，这事儿他是真的不占理。

    “庄、庄伯父，我知罪，我真的知罪！那天是……”他连爹都不敢叫了。

    “住口！”庄天涯打断他。

    “新婚之夜，抛下新婚妻子，去哄什么魔门妖女！你当我月华宫的女儿是什么？你当我庄天涯是什么？！”

    庄天涯说着，更是小嘴抹了蜜，喷出了一堆C语言，听的在场玄天宗高层的脸一阵白一阵红。
content_en:
Seeing Lu Chen leave, Hu Wei picked up the teacup and took a slow sip.

"Madam, do you think this boy is hiding something from me? I always feel like he has something on his mind?"

Chen Xuejiao's eyelashes trembled slightly, but her face remained calm: "What can happen? The child is old and has his own thoughts."

"Yes." Hu Wei nodded, "It's just too worrying. Isn't it ridiculous that we haven't gotten married at this time?"

Chen Xuejiao lowered her eyes and said softly, "Hmm", but her fingertips tightened slightly.

"Master, senior brother, he is a decisive person. I think he will find a Taoist companion soon!" Zhang Fan stood up and spoke appropriately.

"Don't cover for him! I haven't told you about your problem yet! You only have two spiritual roots, and your cultivation speed is more than twice as fast as your senior brother. Up to now, you are only at the eighth level of foundation building. Have you already practiced on a dog?"

Zhang Fan: "..."

He could tell that Lao Deng just wanted to train people, and no matter what he did, it wouldn't work.

"Come with me, I'll get some small gifts for my disciple!" Hu Wei said, got up and walked towards the house.

"Yes!" Zhang Fan quickly followed his son in his arms, while Chen Xuejiao and Yu Ning were waiting outside.

After watching her husband leave, Chen Xuejiao slowly breathed a sigh of relief and raised her hand to press her heart.

It just jumped a little fast there.

But just such a small movement was caught in Yu Ning's eyes.

…

Two days passed by in a flash.

Hu Wei was right. After Zhuang Jingbai went back to complain, Father Zhuang actually brought a bunch of monks from Yuehua Palace to Xuantian Sect to ask for an explanation!

The atmosphere in the Xuantian Sect's meeting hall was solemn.

Lin Tian stood in the center of the hall with his head lowered, flanked by the embarrassed Xuantian Sect leader and several leaders.

Lu Chen was also pulled aside by Hu Wei to watch the show.

Opposite, the men and horses of Yuehua Palace were menacing.

The middle-aged man at the head is wearing a black robe and has a majestic face. He is the master of Yuehua Palace and Zhuang Jingbai's father, Zhuang Tianya.

Behind him stood more than a dozen Yuehua Palace elders, all of whom had deep auras and were at the lowest level of Jindan cultivation.

Zhuang Jingbai stood beside his father, dressed in white, with a cold expression, his eyes fell on Lin Tian, ​​showing no emotion or anger.

"Lin Tian! Do you know your guilt?!"

Lin Tian's legs softened when he heard this and he almost knelt down. He was really unreasonable about this matter.

"Uncle Zhuang, I know my guilt, I really do! That day was..." He didn't even dare to call him dad.

"Shut up!" Zhuang Tianya interrupted him.

"On your wedding night, you abandoned your newlywed wife to coax some demon sect girl! Who do you think I am, the daughter of Yuehua Palace? Who do you think I am, Zhuang Tianya?!"

As Zhuang Tianya spoke, he even smeared honey on his mouth and spat out a bunch of C language. The faces of the senior officials of Xuantian Sect present turned white and red.
